# A path that fits two people talking

The new chairs are popular, but two people talking beside them block the narrow path. Moved the stepping stones before asking people to stop gathering there. [[Garden notebook]]: if the social use succeeds, the physical plan may need to change. A drawing that assumes everyone keeps moving will call ordinary conversation an obstruction.
